title: La Panhypocrisiade, ou le spectacle infernal du seizième siècle
summary: "La Panhypocrisiade, ou le spectacle infernal du seizième siècle" by Népomucène Lemercier is a French poem in 16 cantos composed mainly during the Consulate but published in 1819.
